zh: 有效子数组的首尾值相同，variance就是其中不等于首尾值的元素个数。如果中间还夹着同样的值，把区间缩到相邻两次出现之间不会更差。
所以只需要考虑同一个值相邻两次出现的位置j<i，此时variance就是i−j−1；对所有这样的相邻出现对取最小值。
用哈希表记录每个值上一次出现的下标；从左到右扫描，若当前值出现过，用i−last[v]−1更新最小值，然后把last[v]更新为i。最后输出最小值。
en: A valid subarray has equal ends, and its variance is the number of elements different from that end value. If the same value also occurs in between, shrinking to two consecutive occurrences is never worse.
So only consecutive occurrences j < i of the same value matter, and then the variance is i - j - 1; take the minimum over all such pairs.

Keep a hash map from each value to the index of its previous occurrence; scanning left to right, when the current value has been seen, update the minimum with i - last[v] - 1, then set last[v] = i. Print the minimum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each value, only compare the index difference minus 1 between two consecutive occurrences, and take the minimum.

## Proof of correctness

If the endpoint value occurs more than twice in a valid range, its number of non-endpoint values equals the sum of the numbers of other elements in the gaps between consecutive occurrences of that value, and a sum of non-negative terms is no less than its smallest term. Hence some pair of consecutive occurrences gives an answer that is no worse, and it suffices to enumerate those pairs.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
